scenarios.product-analyst: For example: Clarify the member invitation flow, permissions, and acceptance criteria.
scenarios.architect: For example: Design real-time task notifications, including reconnects and permission checks.
scenarios.implementer: For example: Add search and pagination to the project member list, with tests.
scenarios.qa-engineer: For example: Test member invitations for expiry, duplicate acceptance, and permissions.
scenarios.diagnostician: For example: Find why the task list slows down with many members and propose a verified fix.
scenarios.code-reviewer: For example: Review task bulk editing for permissions, partial failures, and test coverage.
scenarios.security-reviewer: For example: Review file uploads for access control and unsafe file handling.
scenarios.release-engineer: For example: Prepare the member permissions release checklist, dependencies, and rollback steps.
scenarios.technical-writer: For example: Write a getting-started guide for task automation with a working example.
scenarios.progress-reporter: For example: Summarize this week’s invitation feature progress, blockers, and next steps.
scenarios.reliability-engineer: For example: Investigate duplicate notifications and propose retry and deduplication safeguards.
scenarios.agent-evaluator: For example: Compare two code-review prompts using missed defects and false positives.
scenarios.experience-validation-engineer: For example: Check task creation for keyboard access, narrow layouts, and failure recovery.
scenarios.migration-reviewer: For example: Review a new task status migration for backfill, compatibility, and rollback risks.
scenarios.feature-delivery: For example: Coordinate the squad to deliver member invitations, from requirements through testing.
scenarios.bug-fix: For example: Coordinate investigation, repair, and regression testing for stale tasks after switching projects.
scenarios.review-gate: For example: Coordinate code, security, and test reviews for the file upload release.
scenarios.discovery: For example: Clarify the users, scope, and technical options for a cross-project progress view.
scenarios.docs: For example: Coordinate writing and review of the task automation configuration guide.
scenarios.maintenance: For example: Investigate intermittent tests after a database driver upgrade and verify a fix.
scenarios.release: For example: Coordinate release readiness checks for member permissions, including rollback.
scenarios.incident: For example: Coordinate investigation and recovery for a spike in task creation errors.
scenarios.mika: For example: Turn member invitation requirements into clear tasks and suggest suitable agents.
scenarios.custom_agent: For example: {{name}}, apply your responsibilities ({{description}}) to member invitations and identify deliverables.
scenarios.custom_squad: For example: {{name}}, use the squad’s responsibilities ({{description}}) to plan member invitation work.
scenarios.generic_agent: For example: {{name}}, assess the member invitation requirements and identify what you can deliver.
scenarios.generic_squad: For example: {{name}}, plan the squad’s roles and acceptance checks for member invitations.
